implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Provides the navigation header, breadcrumbs for page context, and displays feedback messages (notice/alert) for all event actions.
implementation.name: application.html.erb (Navigation, Breadcrumbs, Flash Messaging)
implementation.pseudo_code:
Render navigation header with links to Home, All Events, and New Event
Render breadcrumbs based on current path:
  IF on Home: show Home
  IF on Events index: show Home > Events
  IF on New Event: show Home > Events > New Event
  IF on Edit Event: show Home > Events > [Event Title] > Edit
  IF on Show Event: show Home > Events > [Event Title]
Display notice and alert messages if present
Render the main content

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Displays a list of all events, each with title, description, assigned user count, and actions for view, edit, and remove. Provides navigation to add a new event.
implementation.name: index.html.erb (Event Listing)
implementation.pseudo_code:
FOR each event in @events:
  Display event title, description, and assigned user count
  Provide buttons for View, Edit, and Remove (with confirmation)
IF no events exist:
  Show message to add the first event

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Displays event details, including assigned users (with names and avatars), and provides navigation for editing or removing the event.
implementation.name: show.html.erb (Event Detail View)
implementation.pseudo_code:
Display event title and description
IF assigned users exist:
  FOR each assigned user:
    Show user name and avatar
ELSE:
  Show 'No users assigned' message
Provide Edit and Remove buttons

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Returns the list of user objects assigned to the event by fetching user details from the external service.
implementation.name: Event#assigned_users
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF assigned_user_ids is blank:
  Return empty array
FOR each id in assigned_user_ids:
  Fetch user from external service
Return list of user objects

implementation.How_is_it_connected_to_implementation: Fetches a single user's details from the external API, used for displaying assigned users in event details.
implementation.name: JsonplaceholderService.fetch_user
implementation.pseudo_code:
IF user is cached:
  Return cached user
ELSE:
  Make HTTP GET request to external /users/:id endpoint
  Parse and return user
  Cache result
